title.narrative: We Effect - Sustainable Watering Systems Inception Phase
We Effect - Sustainable Watering Systems Inception Phase

description.narrative:
Objectives:
I. To design a technically, economically and politically viable and sustainable programme aimed at reducing poverty, creating employment and trade, by increasing the income and quality of life of the target groups.
II. To connect Sweden and Guatemala by establishing a roadmap for the generation of a business climate and initial public-private ecosystem for the implementation of the Sustainable Watering Systems and Value Chains Program in Guatemala.
III. To identify strategic partners and allies from the public and private sectors in Guatemala and Sweden, as well as other key actors who provide technical and financial resources during the inception stage and during the implementation of the programme.

The inception phase aims to design a programme including sustainable watering systems using renewable energy (such as solar-powered) and smart farming technology , to support small farmers to save water, be more independent and secure more profitable production for their insertion in value chains.

As a preparatory phase, and with the aim of understanding the country's offerings of companies that distribute sustainable irrigation technologies, particularly solar-powered irrigation systems. Currently, companies some companies have been identified.
-We Effect established collaboration agreement with the Vice Ministry of Rural Development (VIDER) of the Ministry of Agriculture (MAGA). This entity is responsible for implementing the National Irrigation Policy 20242033, which aims to accelerate and expand access to irrigation technology for sustainable production and productivity in the country. We Effect is working with VIDER to establish a national technical irrigation round table, which will include the participation of various institutions and organizations involved in the irrigation sector.
-With the objective to identify potential target groups and allied institutions, during the inception phase, We Effect established contacts and alliances with various civil society, Indigenous, and peasant organizations, as well as with national and international companies, NGOs, financial institutions, among others linked to the subject, who are considered potential long-term partners for the irrigation project.
-On-site, information was successfully gathered regarding the needs, situation, and conditions of the producers, as well as their productive potential. This has made it possible to formulate a project document based on the needs and realities of the target groups, as well as the territories and value chains with the greatest productive potential, economic development, and market opportunities in different regions of the country.
